lines.2: She was efficient right up until bedtime.
lines.5: 「Oh, I was just wondering how things were going...」
lines.7: 「Why are you getting nervous on your own?」
lines.8: 「Because having a woman that beautiful under the same roof is totally unfair!」
lines.9: 「Oh, right. Give back that thing I lent you today. Bring it tomorrow.」
lines.11: 「Yeah. She isn't the kind of person who'd go rummaging through my desk drawers after all.」
lines.17: I had no time for a guy like that.
lines.18: Today had been one hell of an eventful day.
lines.19: I wondered what tomorrow would bring--
